name: vlc-style-gestures

checks.check: A: Kestrel's own player started the five-minute film and showed its first picture
A: a drag UP on the right side raises the volume ([])
A: a drag DOWN on the right side lowers it
A: a drag up on the left side changes the brightness ([])
A: a vertical drag in the middle changes nothing (VLC's dead zone)
A: a plain sideways drag (no long press at all) seeks forward ([])
A: a finger resting on the left side is told 'Slide up or down for brightness' (never 'slide left or right to seek' on a side)
A: a finger resting on the right side is told 'Slide up or down for volume' (never 'slide left or right to seek' on a side)
A: a finger resting on the middle side is told 'Slide left or right to seek' (never 'slide left or right to seek' on a side)
A: after a rest, a drag right of about 4 cm still jumps forward by tens of seconds ([])
A: the film really got the command (a skip)
A: and with no rest at all the same drag jumps the same ([] s against [] s)
A: the farther the drag the bigger the jump (6 cm: [] s against 4 cm: [] s)
A: a drag that also goes an inch up is finer (about a third: [] s against [] s)
A: a double tap on the right side jumps 10 s forward
A: and the controls are away again (the first tap showed them at once, the seek put them away): shown 0, hidden 0
A: Back ends the player and the brightness is the tablet's again
B: the page told where its film is

numbers: A no rest + 4 cm right: jumps []
A fine: plain [] s, with 1 inch up [] s
